meta.name: sigma_ingest
meta.description: Extract durable ktx wiki knowledge from staged Sigma data model specs and workbook summaries. Load for WorkUnits with unitKey sigma-data-models or sigma-workbooks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从Sigma数据模型和工作簿中提取知识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Sigma数据规范中提取结构化知识
copy.tagline_en: Extract knowledge from Sigma data models and workbooks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract structured knowledge from Sigma data specifications

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从 Sigma 数据模型和 workbook 摘要中提取业务知识，写入 wiki 页面。它不会修改已有的语义层（SL）源。
howto.when: 当工作单元（WorkUnit）的 unitKey 为 sigma-data-models 或 sigma-workbooks 时触发。通常由 memory_agent 调用。

say.text: 请从 Sigma 数据模型“Revenue Model”中提取业务知识。
分析 Sigma workbook“ARR Tracker”的摘要信息。
say.note: Claude 会从名称和描述中提取可复用的业务概念。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude extracts business knowledge from Sigma data model specs and workbook summaries and writes wiki candidates. It does not modify existing SL sources.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the WorkUnit has unitKey sigma-data-models or sigma-workbooks. Typically called by memory_agent.

say_en.text: Extract business knowledge from Sigma data model "Revenue Model".
Analyze the summary of Sigma workbook "ARR Tracker".
say_en.note: Claude extracts reusable business concepts from name and description.
